scope: Super-admin-reviewed exact laboratory mappings, explicit admission-bound reviewed original lab source registrations, default v2 risk windows with v1 compatibility, independent risk Prompts, business and Super-admin UI, queue/inflight/history source guards, bounded full-source storage, and actual route/ORM inventory. No clinical risk model delivered in this batch.

inventory.matrix_scope: Mounted app.routers.* APIRoute method/path multiset; existing main GET / welcome entry explicitly excluded

mapping_contract.matching: Exact original identity and case-sensitive namespace/code/unit/method/specimen; no display-name inference, missing-field wildcard, unit conversion or cross-system local-code merge. Python exact filtering also checked with real MySQL case-insensitive collation.
mapping_contract.publication: Immutable draft revision 1; two explicit literal confirmations and review note publish revision 2; nullable unique active identity slot; irreversible CAS withdrawal, with content and governance hashes and transactional audit.

source_contract.revoke: Ordinary original authors require current same-admission care/read authorization; an original author whose current role changed to nurse can still revoke via API. Actual Super-admin may revoke a frozen source even if its original admission was deleted, using the stored original scope. Nursing UI offers read-only registered-source access and no candidate/create/revoke controls.
source_contract.scope: Explicit patient and real admission under existing care/grant authorization; same-patient reviewed candidates do not establish admission membership. No date-based binding or source-authorship self-grant.
source_contract.attestation: Separate literal confirmations and meaningful notes for collection UTC, original admission membership and source namespace; notes remain attestations, not independently verified measurement facts.
source_contract.review: Original report reviewed and order in reviewed state; auditor exists, and when a technician exists the auditor differs. Machine LIS entry with no technician is not proof of two human reviews.
source_contract.quantity: Original database Decimal(24,8) formatted as decimal text, including zero/NULL/qualitative originals; no original-input lexical/trailing-zero or extra precision claim.
source_contract.legacy_clock: Original naive database values retained, serialized with six fractional places without Z; this does not increase original acquisition/database precision or establish a timezone.
source_contract.timing: Explicit attested collected_at_utc, seconds/offset and at most six fractional places; registered_at == available_at are server registration UTC, not historical LIS first-issued UTC.
source_contract.identity_and_lifecycle: One active registration per original observation globally across admissions and mappings; active revision 1 to irreversible revoked revision 2, CAS and audit atomicity; correction requires withdrawal and separately verified new registration.
source_contract.raw_hash: Original observation plus patient/parent report/order chain, original review facts and complete parent clinical text. Workflow critical-value handling and sync-only fields excluded.

window_contract.v1: Preserved original builder and exact canonical snapshot behavior; later registered labs do not augment or change v1/hash, and valid ordinary historical reads remain supported.
window_contract.v1_ast_normalization: Function name, SCHEMA_VERSION constant alias and added explanatory docstring only
window_contract.lab_selection: collected_at_utc in [start,end] AND registered_at <= as_of AND available_at <= as_of; mapping must have been published by source registration. No query/count of unregistered or future sources.
window_contract.snapshot_basis: current_snapshot_retrospective, not historical database as-of replay

engineering_limits.source_or_window_oversize: Reject without truncation; prior window context byte budget unchanged

window_contract.projection_integrity: Full parent content remains bound by original/source hashes, so omitted-text edits invalidate prior windows; only explicit free-text fields minimized, protected decimals/units/times/technical IDs remain original. Not an anonymization guarantee.
window_contract.quality: Eligible governance subset, numeric/qualitative counts, revoked source or mapping exclusions, exact-identity same-time duplicate/conflict groups; no last-row selection, averaging or qualitative-to-numeric conversion.
window_contract.staleness: Original content/ownership/review or mapping/source lifecycle changes reject queued/inflight/ordinary old results; Super-admin frozen audit retained, actual new execution still verifies current sources.

frontend_integrity_fixes.full_v2_member_required: Metadata-only lab source bodies are valid in directories but rejected inside a verified v2 window; require non-null object body, known risk projection, patient/admission and original parent/mapping chain.
frontend_integrity_fixes.findings: Both selection and displayed frozen findings use the complete window scope/structure guard.
frontend_integrity_fixes.initial_selection: A deep-linked window may be initially selected once per patient/admission/initial-ID identity; refresh, source change, window creation, session/role change or deactivation cannot silently reselect the old ID.
frontend_integrity_fixes.late_reply: Source changes invalidate pending directory and detail epochs, clear selection and require explicit re-selection; no automatic model invocation.

backend.database: SQLite memory test override, synthetic fixtures; optional real-model tests remain explicitly skipped
backend.warning_note: Existing temporary SECRET_KEY and deliberately invalid pydicom DS NaN fixture warnings retained

browser.command: E2E_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4180 npx playwright test e2e/ai-*.spec.js e2e/diagnosis-review.spec.js e2e/request-real-http.spec.js --workers=2 --reporter=list

earlier_full_attempt.failure: Existing ADR source-evidence dialog absent at assertion after click; no product/assertion change was made to bypass it.

node_selector.scope: Actual SFC script with real Vue reactivity and synthetic injected APIs/macros/lifecycle; no browser or HTTP

verify.warning_note: Existing vab.scss mixed-decls warnings remain unsuppressed

actual_isolated_mysql.scope: Actual two new Alembic revision functions and original mapping/source/window/revocation/history helpers on real private MySQL with synthetic FK prerequisites; not hospital HTTP/bootstrap, inference, deployment or clinical validation.
limitations: Synthetic engineering verification only; no real patient records or paid/model requests.
Old clocks stay naive and unknown; server registered availability is not historical LIS issued UTC.
Existing v1 window was materialized with original versioned build_snapshot plus ORM, because create_window now creates v2.
